worksheet.placeholder: E.g. Worksheet about fractions for 3rd grade, with clear instructions, tasks suited to the goal and a closing activity

active.label: Active learning
active.description: Students take an active part in hands-on activities and collaborative projects.

lecture.label: Lecture-style teaching
lecture.description: The teacher presents the content directly while students take it in and take notes.

practical.label: Practical learning
practical.description: Shows how the content applies to real professions, preparing students for real-world challenges.

socialEmotional.label: Social-emotional learning
socialEmotional.description: Combines academic content with social-emotional skills such as empathy and teamwork.

interactive.label: Interactive learning
interactive.description: Brings in digital resources and interactivity, connecting the content to students' everyday lives.

practice.label: Practice and consolidate
practice.description: A worksheet with progressive exercises to practice and reinforce learning.

diagnostic.label: Diagnose knowledge
diagnostic.description: Helps identify the starting point, gaps and common mistakes before the topic.

formative.label: Track learning
formative.description: Supports monitoring, self-assessment and next steps throughout the work.

exploration.label: Introduce new content
exploration.description: Uses prompts and guided questions to explore ideas before formal practice.
